verdict.rationale: Greptile is a SaaS code-review platform with API-key access, so a downloadable API spec is a fair question for it. However, the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returned 404, and nothing in the docs mentions a machine-readable API spec. The llms.txt docs index and the MCP server are adjacent features, not an API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
